query: measured cost of methods for Publish the stage-2 inlier-face width, height, and depth in metres on /pps/pallet_pose_rich with the pose from that same estimate. Width is the camera-x span of the inlier face, height is the camera-y span, and depth is the mean range. The vehicle's dynamic handling process can then size the pallet from the pose it is about to use while the scene can still change.
findings: The specified width, height, and depth are one linear pass: max(x)-min(x), max(y)-min(y), and the mean range of the same inliers. An axis-aligned box is that pass. A minimum-volume oriented box is a different problem; O'Rourke's exact method took nearly a week per model, while a rotation-group fit still took about 20 minutes including the convex hull (Chang et al., 2011).

pcl::getMinMax3D measured about 15-17x slower than a scalar min/max loop on 1.75-18 MB clouds (10-trial average). Each point builds an Eigen::Map. A Release build with SSE removes most of that gap (Stack Overflow 35669182). A second call for the mean is a second walk of the same inliers.

A covariance or PCA size is the costly sibling and is not camera-x span or mean range. computeMeanAndCovarianceMatrix through Vector4fMap measured about 4x a scalar product loop (0.25 s vs 0.09 s over 100k runs); the centroid itself did not get slower (PCL PR 4106). Gottschalk et al. (1996) put a minimal enclosing ellipsoid at linear time with a constant near 3e5, too heavy to use on large sets.

Three metres on the same small pose message stay in the flat ROS 2 size band. Kronauer et al. (SenSys 2021) measured equal end-to-end latency at 128 B, 1 KB, and 10 KB on an i7, with the rise only at 100 KB and 500 KB once UDP fragments past 64 KB. Three float64 fields are 24 bytes.

A second topic pays another full hop, not 24 bytes. In that study latency grew with node count, and for a 128 B payload most time was DDS plus the rclcpp notification delay, with ROS 2 adding up to 50% over raw DDS. Intra-process does not help messages of 10-100 bytes and is worth it from about 5 KB (ROS 2 intraprocess design). Composed intra-process latency was a flat 40 us across sizes (arXiv:2305.09933). Humble Fast-DDS 1:1 UDP at a 4 KB buffer was 0.073 ms versus 0.060 ms zero-copy (OSRF Sony report).

Measured pallet pose pipelines are tens to hundreds of milliseconds, so this reduction is not that cost. A monocular metric-depth pallet pipeline was 27.5 ms end to end (depth 7.73 ms, pose net 5.49 ms) on an RTX 4090 (VISAPP 2026). Occlusion-robust pose estimates were 87 ms, and Bohacs et al. about 300 ms. Intel's PCL timings put the heavy work on RANSAC plane fit at 120k points (AVX-512 gained 10-30%) and on clustering once the cloud exceeds about 5000 points.
citations: Chang, Gorissen, Melchior, Fast oriented bounding box optimization on the rotation group SO(3), 2011, https://perso.uclouvain.be/chia-tche.chang/resources/CGM11_paper.pdf
